units.source_text: 藤壶皇后之兄兵部卿亲王也常来访晤源氏大将。

en.t: The Minister of War Prince, elder brother of Empress Fujitsubo, also often came to visit General Genji.

units.source_text: 这亲王长于吹弹歌舞，风流潇洒，与大将志同道合。

en.t: This prince excelled at wind and string music, singing, and dancing; he was elegant and free-spirited, and shared the general's tastes and ideals.
